title: 第13章 寻香追迹第14章 第二个据点
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 第13章寻香追迹
嘭的一声，一位满脸胡茬的男子被撞到了墙上。
还未等他反应过来，一把镜面般透亮的长剑就架在了他的脖颈上。那锋利的长剑轻松切断了他的碎发，吓得男子神情慌乱全身肌肉僵硬。
他恐惧地看向持剑者，是新约镇的镇长，此地的男爵。
镇长暴怒地瞪着男子，逼问道：“说！你们把我女儿弄哪里去了？！”
“不不不敢，我们不敢啊镇长大人！我们不敢绑架贵族的啊！”男子慌乱地解释，眼珠子也不断瞟向脖颈旁的长剑。
哪怕双手挥得飞快，他的脖子也不敢有任何动作，生怕这位贵族手滑抹了他的脖子。
“不敢？那你又要如何解释这个东西？！”镇长收回长剑，一个摆腿踢在了男子的侧脑。
这一脚来的突然，男子毫无防备，噗通一声倒在了地上。
待他在剧痛之后睁开双眼，一些暗淡的、在光线下呈现出漂亮流光彩的花瓣就散落在他面前，落在地上距他的瞳孔也不过几寸。
男子认得这东西，是灵匣子的花瓣，也是他们一个小集团用来确认绑架目标的重要道具。
“我在我女儿房间里发现了这个东西，你又要怎么解释？”镇长再问男子。
“我真不知道啊镇长大人！我今天才被抓过来的啊！”男子狼狈的起身，连滚带爬来到镇长面前。
他开口不断央求，却是忽然想起了什么，又开口道：“我、我上级是一个叫莫扎利亚的人，他在镇上开花店，他虽然是亚里罗人但他有菲尔斯王国的爵位！”
“他已经变成魔族逃跑了！混账！”镇长勃然大怒，再一脚踢翻男子，随后把手中长剑交给身边的骑士。
被踢倒的男子眼看镇长转身离开，惊恐地伸手想要挽留。忽然捕捉了一道银光，男子转头，骑士高举长剑的姿态映入了他的眼眸。
挥剑——
咔嚓一声，猩红的鲜血溅到了地上的花瓣上。
灵匣子那暗淡的流光色似乎远不如那些血液鲜艳……
“抱歉，我之前收到的灵匣子已经被骑士们处理了。”
一栋民房前，牵着黑色猎犬的唐与姆莉意外地看着面前这位被他们救回的女子。
“不好意思……”下一处。
“很抱歉，你们来晚了。”再下一处。
“骑士们已经收走了。”又下一处。
摇头。
摆手。
一次又一次。
唐与姆莉失落的坐在路边，托着腮帮子，神情苦恼着，但趴在地上啃骨头的猎犬小黑却没有这样的烦恼。
“唐，所有灵匣子都被骑士团销毁了，接下来你有什么想法吗？”姆莉转头询问唐。
唐摇着脑袋，此时也不知道该如何是好，只是默默看着啃骨头的小黑。
“有镇长女儿的那件衣物也不能找到她吗？”姆莉再问。
唐立即摇头，解释道：“小黑没反应，味道似乎很淡，只能用作小范围的精确搜索，想要寻一个大概范围还是需要用灵匣子。”
似乎考虑到姆莉无法理解其中缘由，唐又补充道：“那些人贩子在镇上通过灵匣子拐人的时间已经超过了一个月，路径上灵匣子的味道是最清晰的，想要寻人非灵匣子不可。”

Chapter 13 Looking for Incense and Tracking It
With a bang, a stubble-faced man was knocked against the wall.
Before he could react, a long sword as clear as a mirror was placed on his neck. The sharp long sword easily cut off his hair, which frightened the man into a panic and his whole body muscles stiffened.
He looked at the man holding the sword in fear. He was the mayor of New Testament Town and the baron here.
The mayor glared at the man angrily and asked, "Say! Where did you do my daughter?!"
"No, no, we don't dare, Mr. Mayor! We don't dare kidnap the nobles!" The man explained in a panic, his eyes constantly glancing at the sword beside his neck.
Even if he waved his hands quickly, he did not dare to make any movement on his neck, for fear that the nobleman's hand would slip and rub his neck.
"Don't dare? Then how are you going to explain this thing?!" The mayor retracted his sword and kicked the man in the side of the head with his leg.
The kick came so suddenly that the man was unprepared and fell to the ground with a thud.
When he opened his eyes after the severe pain, some dim petals that showed a beautiful luster under the light were scattered in front of him, falling on the ground only a few inches away from his pupils.
The man recognized this thing as the petals of the spirit box, and it was also an important tool used by their small group to identify the kidnapping target.
"I found this thing in my daughter's room, how do you explain it?" the mayor asked the man again.
"I really don't know, Mr. Mayor! I was just arrested today!" The man got up in a panic and crawled to the mayor.
He kept pleading, but suddenly remembered something, and said again: "My, my superior is a man named Mozalia. He runs a flower shop in the town. Although he is from Yaliluo, he has the title of the Kingdom of Phils!"
"He has turned into a demon and escaped! Bastard!" The mayor was furious, kicked the man over again, and then handed the sword in his hand to the knight beside him.
The man who was kicked down saw the mayor turning around and leaving, and stretched out his hands in horror to try to keep him. Suddenly catching a ray of silver light, the man turned his head, and the knight's posture holding the sword high came into his eyes.
Swinging the sword——
There was a click, and scarlet blood splashed onto the petals on the ground.
The dim flowing color of the spirit box seems far less bright than the blood...
"Sorry, the spirit box I received earlier has been processed by the knights."
In front of a private house, Tang and Muli, who were holding black hounds, looked at the woman they rescued in front of them in surprise.
"Sorry..." Next point.
"Sorry, you're late." Next.
"The knights have taken it away." Another place.
Shake his head.
Wave your hands.
again and again.
Tang and Muli were sitting on the side of the road in despair, holding their cheeks and looking troubled, but the hound Xiao Hei who was lying on the ground chewing bones did not have such troubles.
"Tang, all the spirit boxes have been destroyed by the Knights. What do you have in mind next?" Muli turned to ask Tang.
Tang shook his head. He didn't know what to do at this time. He just looked at Xiao Hei who was chewing the bones silently.
"Can't we find the mayor's daughter even if she has the clothes on her?" Muli asked again.
Tang immediately shook his head and explained: "Xiao Hei didn't respond. The smell seems very weak. It can only be used for precise searches in a small area. If you want to find a general range, you still need to use the spirit box."
As if considering that Mu Li could not understand the reason, Tang added: "Those human traffickers have been kidnapping people through the spirit box in the town for more than a month. The smell of the spirit box on the path is the clearest. If you want to find people, you must use the spirit box."
